- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]

You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

You and Lima play 3 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 100 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

forced_coordination/minimal.system:
You are Kilo, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Lima.

THE KITCHEN
Your team scores points by delivering things at the serving hatch. How the kitchen works is for you to find out by playing.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
- interact(target): walk to the target and interact with it. The target is a pot (e.g. interact(pot_1)) or the (x, y) of any non-floor tile, e.g. interact(0, 1). What happens depends on what is there and what you hold. If nothing would happen yet, you wait there for up to 10 steps until something can; then the action fails.
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way.
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10).
Walking is automatic: shortest path, one tile per step.

THE SEASON
You and Lima play 3 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 100 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Lima. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Charlie.text:
You are Charlie, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Zulu.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
No counter is reachable by both cooks: you can't pass items to each other.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Zulu.text:
You are Zulu, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Charlie.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
No counter is reachable by both cooks: you can't pass items to each other.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

THE SEASON
You and Charlie play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Charlie. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Your team scores points by delivering things at the serving hatch. How the kitchen works is for you to find out by playing.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
- interact(target): walk to the target and interact with it. The target is a pot (e.g. interact(pot_1)) or the (x, y) of any non-floor tile, e.g. interact(0, 1). What happens depends on what is there and what you hold. If nothing would happen yet, you wait there for up to 10 steps until something can; then the action fails.
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way.
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10).
Walking is automatic: shortest path, one tile per step.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Charlie.text:
You are Charlie, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Zulu.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
Counters both cooks can reach (for passing items): (1,0), (2,0), (0,1), (2,2), (4,2), (4,3), (3,4).
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Charlie.text:
You are Charlie, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Zulu.

THE KITCHEN
Your team scores points by delivering things at the serving hatch. How the kitchen works is for you to find out by playing.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
- interact(target): walk to the target and interact with it. The target is a pot (e.g. interact(pot_1)) or the (x, y) of any non-floor tile, e.g. interact(0, 1). What happens depends on what is there and what you hold. If nothing would happen yet, you wait there for up to 10 steps until something can; then the action fails.
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way.
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10).
Walking is automatic: shortest path, one tile per step.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

You are Charlie, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Zulu.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
Counters both cooks can reach (for passing items): (1,0), (2,0), (5,0), (6,0), (0,1), (7,1), (2,2), (3,2), (4,2), (5,2), (0,3), (7,3), (1,4), (2,4), (5,4), (6,4).
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Zulu.text:
You are Zulu, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Charlie.

THE KITCHEN
Your team scores points by delivering things at the serving hatch. How the kitchen works is for you to find out by playing.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
- interact(target): walk to the target and interact with it. The target is a pot (e.g. interact(pot_1)) or the (x, y) of any non-floor tile, e.g. interact(0, 1). What happens depends on what is there and what you hold. If nothing would happen yet, you wait there for up to 10 steps until something can; then the action fails.
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way.
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10).
Walking is automatic: shortest path, one tile per step.

THE SEASON
You and Charlie play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Charlie. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
Counters both cooks can reach (for passing items): (2,1), (2,2), (2,3).
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

Zulu.text:
You are Zulu, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Charlie.

THE KITCHEN
Onion soup = 3 onions in a pot; then someone with empty hands must start_cooking; it cooks for 20 steps; then plate it with a dish (plate_soup) and serve it at the serving hatch: +20 points per soup. Soups with fewer than 3 onions score 0. You can hold one item at a time.
Counters both cooks can reach (for passing items): (2,1), (2,2), (2,3).
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
You choose high-level actions; walking there is automatic (shortest path, one tile per step) and the action finishes when you interact. Actions:
- get_onion: pick up an onion from the onion crate (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- get_dish: pick up a dish from the dish rack (or a counter) [hold: nothing]
- put_in_pot: put the onion you hold into a pot that is not full [hold: onion]
- start_cooking: start cooking a pot that has onions in it [hold: nothing]
- plate_soup: scoop a cooked soup from a pot onto your dish (waits by the pot while it cooks) [hold: dish]
- serve: deliver the soup you hold at the serving hatch [hold: soup]
- place_on_counter: put what you hold on an empty counter [hold: anything]
- pick_up_from_counter: pick up an item from a counter [hold: nothing]
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way [hold: anything]
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10) [hold: anything]
Every action except move_to and wait takes an optional target: a pot for pot actions (put_in_pot(pot_2)) or the (x, y) of a tile (pick_up_from_counter(3, 2)). Without a target you use the nearest suitable one (put_in_pot: the fullest pot that isn't full). If there is nothing to do yet (e.g. no item on the counter), you wait (by the target, if you named one) for up to 10 steps; then the action fails.

THE SEASON
You and Charlie play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Charlie. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.

Charlie.text:
You are Charlie, one of two cooks in a kitchen game. Your teammate is Zulu.

THE KITCHEN
Your team scores points by delivering things at the serving hatch. How the kitchen works is for you to find out by playing.
Cooks can't walk through each other. Walking goes around your teammate if there is another way; if there isn't, you wait, and after 8 blocked steps the action fails.

ACTIONS
- interact(target): walk to the target and interact with it. The target is a pot (e.g. interact(pot_1)) or the (x, y) of any non-floor tile, e.g. interact(0, 1). What happens depends on what is there and what you hold. If nothing would happen yet, you wait there for up to 10 steps until something can; then the action fails.
- move_to(x, y): walk to the floor tile (x, y), e.g. to get out of your teammate's way.
- wait(n): stand still for n steps (1-10).
Walking is automatic: shortest path, one tile per step.

THE SEASON
You and Zulu play 2 rounds in the same kitchen. Each round lasts 24 steps and starts afresh (empty pots, everyone back at the start). Before each round there is a chat on the board; after each round there is a debrief where you see the score.

DECIDING
During a round, whenever you have no plan (at the start, or when your plan is done or has failed) you decide: call act(plan) with up to 5 actions. The game waits while you decide. In a decision you may also call post(message) and read_board().

THE BOARD
A message board shared by you and Zulu. post(message) puts a message of at most 200 characters on it. During a round your state shows how many posts you have not read; read_board() reads them and is free. In the chat before a round you take turns: on your turn you may call post(message) and/or ready(), or reply without a tool call to pass. The chat ends when you have both called ready() or used all 4 posts.

YOUR NOTEPAD
A private note only you can see, shown to you at every decision and kept all season. note(text) replaces it.

GOAL
Get the highest team score. You won't score highly unless you work together.
